Thank you for clarifying the onset during physical activity. Given the sudden nature and location, have you experienced any fever, chills, or visible swelling in the lower abdomen or flank? Also, please confirm if you have noticed any blood in your urine or stool.

speaker: Doctor

The blood work and CT scan are normal, which is surprising given your sudden, severe pain during football. Since the urine and imaging are clear, do you feel any sharp, stabbing pain when I press on your lower abdomen and then release? Also, have you had any difficulty passing gas or a change in your bowel movements?

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since your blood work, initial CT, and contrast imaging are all normal, this rules out many acute surgical emergencies. Did the pain completely resolve, or does it persist in a specific spot like the right lower quadrant? Additionally, have you noticed any recent changes in bowel habits, such as constipation or diarrhea?
